headline: Jared Goff, Jahmyr Gibbs lead the Lions' offensive romp in a 45-21 win over the Cardinals
summary: — Jared Goff threw three touchdown passes, Jahmyr Gibbs added 151 yards rushing and two more scores and the Detroit Lions shook off a slow start by scoring 31 straight points to roll past the Arizona Cardinals 45-21 on Sunday.

headline: David Bailey delivers breakthrough performance in Jets' win
summary: Desperate to get back in the win column on Sunday, the New York Jets were lifted 23-year-old rookie David Bailey, who delivered his breakthrough performance, recording three sacks and eight quarterback pressures, in a 17-12 win over the Cleveland Browns.

headline: Wil Lutz's field goals help Broncos surge past winless Chargers in 4th for 23-17 victory
summary: — Wil Lutz kicked a go-ahead 19-yard field goal with 5:07 remaining, lifting the Denver Broncos over the winless and mistake-prone Los Angeles Chargers 23-17 on Sunday.
